title: Predication cell
description: A position in Phi = E x Pi x E: the Frege-saturated (subject, predicate, object) triple. subject and object are entities of E; predicate is of Pi. The cell is a POSITION, not a value -- its value lives in the fiber algebra A_p. (subject, predicate, object) = (e, a, v) of the EAVT row, where e and v are entities and a is a predicate/morphism.
